decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several types of backpacks including tactical, laptop, sling, and technical hiking packs. The QT&QY Military Tactical Backpack (prod_backpacks_057) stood out due to its high rating (4.7), large capacity (45L), and positive reviews regarding its durability and design. In contrast, the Granite Gear (prod_backpacks_041) had significant negative feedback regarding shoulder strap failure, and the KAUKKO (prod_backpacks_184) also had some durability complaints despite its low price. The QT&QY offers the best balance of features, positive customer sentiment, and price.
